text:
incident-bot: PAGE -> observability.alerts: high error-rate + missing traces for tenant PraxisCorp in dedicated-pool eu-west-2. Pager: oncall-sre. Ticket: INC-2026-1134

alexa (oncall-sre): saw the page. confirming — PraxisCorp (VPC, dedicated pool). They report no spans from their live requests since ~08:04 UTC. Logs appear sparse.

miles (infra-eng): i'm seeing ingestion for that pool but a subset of tenant_ids is dropping before the span-upsert stage. looks like a routing key mismatch from the forwarder. digging through forwarder logs now.

tia (customer-success): Praxis is on a rolling deploy and they're already escalated to their security contact. high business impact: ML ranking jobs failing downstream, web console errors for some customers. they asked for ETA on mitigation.

james (eng-ml): impact note — our model serving metrics still show token-level success, but trace coverage for user request->model roundtrip is missing. that means request/response latencies aren't correlated for their tenant. makes debugging impossible for them. :frowning:

alexa (oncall-sre): quick ask: can someone grant temporary read access to Praxis-specific logs for cs team? they can't access VPC export. tia, do you have their audit contact?

tia (customer-success): @alexa i have the contact. they'll accept a temporary signed URL or we can add their CS SAML group to the forwarder-viewer role. which is faster?

miles (infra-eng): fastest is to add forwarder-viewer for the CS group for that tenant folder. i'll prepare the IAM change and post the command so we have an audit trail.

miles (infra-eng): applying change now:
```bash
# grant read-only to cs SAML group for Praxis logs
./iamctl grant --project=observability --principal="group:cs-praxis" --role=forwarder-viewer --scope="tenant:PraxisCorp" --duration=2h
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by miles: iamctl@infra (sha: ab12cd) — started.

miles (infra-eng): IAM change completed. tia, can you confirm CS can see their request logs?

tia (customer-success): confirmed, i can see requests back to ~07:30. spans still absent though. sending link to Praxis team. they want a trace of a specific request id: 3f9a-77b2.

james (eng-ml): found an example in the global aggregator where the request id exists but the span id is null. looks like the forwarder dropped the span payload for ids matching the tenant prefix used by Praxis. extracting sample logs:
```
[forwarder] 2026-03-15T08:03:42Z INFO recv tenant=PraxisCorp req_id=3f9a-77b2 payload_size=12 span_count=0
[forwarder] 2026-03-15T08:03:42Z WARN marshal failed tenant=PraxisCorp err="unknown-schema-v2"
```

alexa (oncall-sre): hmm unknown-schema-v2 — did we roll a change to support new span schema last night? sanjay, any alerts from prod-sec about forwarder schema rollout?

sanjay (prod-sec): we approved the schema migration but flagged a compatibility step. release notes said "compat adapter on by default" but that adapter didn't ship to eu-west-2. looks like a release staging misconfiguration: eu-west-2 forwarder missed the adapter build.

miles (infra-eng): for live mitigation i can flip the forwarder into compatibility mode via remote flag that avoids the strict marshal path. that should let spans through in raw form to the collector and restore visibility. need approval for a config toggle in the pool. impact: slight increase in CPU and temporarily more log volume (~10-15%).

james (eng-ml): +1 for toggle. restores trace correlation quickly. we can postprocess to normalize schema later.

alexa (oncall-sre): approve. do it. also start an audit log entry and link to INC-2026-1134. keep the toggle timeboxed to 1 hour and plan to revert after adapter build is patched.

miles (infra-eng): executing mitigation:
```json
{"action":"set-flag","pool":"dedicated-pool-eu-west-2","flag":"forwarder.compat_mode","value":true}
```

miles (infra-eng): flag applied. collector shows span ingestion resuming for PraxisCorp (testing now).

deploy-bot: rollout event -> config-service@infra (id: cfg-774) completed.

tia (customer-success): Praxis confirmed traces are back for their test requests. they're able to correlate latency. thank you.

james (eng-ml): running a quick check against our evals — trace coverage for Praxis increased from 2% to 98% in the last 5 minutes. pushing a regression alert to the postmortem board.

alexa (oncall-sre): next steps: 1) miles to produce a hotfix build that includes the missing compat adapter for eu-west-2; 2) schedule a maintenance window to perform a safe deploy and revert the compatibility flag; 3) tia to file customer brief and notify SL. I've added tasks to INC-2026-1134.

miles (infra-eng): i'll start the adapter build and a canary deploy to staging. ETA ~2h for build + canary, 4h for safe roll to eu-west-2 if no regressions.

sanjay (prod-sec): we'll also audit the release gating to ensure per-region adapters are validated. cc: security review in the postmortem.

tia (customer-success): Praxis wants a short official note and confirmation once the flag is reverted. i'll draft and share.

alexa (oncall-sre): handing off monitoring to miles for the next 2h. i'm going offline for a meeting but will follow up on the postmortem draft later. tagging oncall-next: @miles (oncall-sre).

miles (infra-eng): acknowledged. monitoring alert created: obs-monitoring@pager -> watch PRACTRA-metrics, span-ingest-rate, forwarder-err-unknown-schema. escalation if span-ingest-rate < 80% for 5m.

incident-bot: NOTE -> escalation policy changed: primary now miles (infra-eng). follow-up: add timeline to INC-2026-1134 and include log samples + config diff.

alexa (oncall-sre): good job team. we'll convert this to a postmortem after the fix. tagging for action items: miles (build + deploy), tia (customer comms), james (eval regression), sanjay (release gating audit).

tia (customer-success): Praxis said they appreciate the quick mitigation — i'll keep them updated. closing customer-impact urgent channel and moving conversation to INC-2026-1134 for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
